methods.population: Final 2021 Census total resident population, all sexes; municipal table 1 column F, settlement table 1 column I. Both workbooks reconciled nationally and for all 555 non-Zagreb units and 21 counties. Zagreb county-level sum checked separately.
methods.bridge: DZS workbooks do not carry unit/settlement codes. RPJ official codes are an identity bridge through exact county, municipality, settlement hierarchy and name. They are not claimed as workbook columns. Official bilingual Istrian names admit their Croatian component only; no fuzzy name matching.
methods.identity: Only matching explicit current city/grad, municipality/općina, locality/naselje type pairs admitted. Require own literal Wikidata P31, name, exact county ancestry, own point and row point inside valid raw same-county RPJ entity. Settlements require a separately verified direct municipal P131 parent and a consistent parent_id if present. Municipality/settlement class conflicts held. Unresolved original keys stay held; no later type or point alone closes their original identity hold.
methods.history: Pinned baseline and later events inspected: 169 Croatian baseline unresolved keys; no subsequent HR events. None admitted here, so no decision_only events are manufactured. Every held row keeps all scalars and its identity status.
methods.recency: No row has population_year newer than 2021, and no own-item P1082 statement has a later P585 year in the retained captures. Existing unproven counts are not treated as newer official counts. A newer dated own-item count would be held for official-source review.
methods.scope: Only population and population_year can change. Every held record remains byte-for-byte equivalent as a JSON object. Formatting and record order retained; population_year placed after population. Raw source archive and geometry fully revalidated.
methods.limitations: RPJ/Wikidata are dated 2026-10-10 captures. All raw bytes verified against acquisition receipts; all 7,336 retained RPJ code/parent/name attributes and raw geometries rederived from the retained archive. No inferred municipal population is assigned to a naselje or vice versa.
